linear_proxy_caveat: A read-only 200k-row cost probe, not a direct profile of every production conversion
overhead_caveat: Includes setup, joblib compression, digest, metadata and log writes; not an isolated serialization benchmark

static_call_audit.flat_xgb: One prediction per role per seed; cached and reused across every taxonomy arm
static_call_audit.each_hierarchy: One prediction per role per seed; cached and reused for equal blend, soft/hard and gate
static_call_audit.cleaning: One clean_features call per role per hierarchy, outside the loop over local family models
static_call_audit.family_predictions: One family and one conditional per non-singleton family, all required for soft factorization
static_call_audit.flat_lgbm_selection: Selection prediction is cached although not consumed by current flat outputs; potentially avoidable in a future version
static_call_audit.production_changes: None: current runner and contracts remain unchanged; no skipped rows, precision changes or estimator changes

worker_plan: One active estimator with n_jobs=2; grouped37 waits for paired completion; validation stages run sequentially
